data.title: Qassim Health Cluster Introduces Robotic-Assisted Knee Replacement Surgery at Uyun Al-Jiwa General Hospital
data.content:
Buraidah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Qassim Health Cluster has introduced robotic-assisted knee replacement surgery at the Center of Excellence for Joint Replacement and Sports Injuries at Uyun Al-Jiwa General Hospital, marking a significant advancement in specialized surgical services. The technology allows joint replacement procedures to be planned and performed with greater precision using modern surgical techniques tailored to each patient's anatomy.
    The cluster said the technology creates a three-dimensional model of the knee joint during surgery without requiring a prior CT scan. This enables the surgeon to determine the appropriate size of the artificial joint and adjust its positioning angles and alignment to the patient's anatomy. It also allows for a precise surgical plan to be prepared before bone cutting begins.
    The robotic system operates under the surgeon's direct control through a smart instrument that guides bone cutting within the limits set in the surgical plan. It stops automatically if those limits are exceeded, enhancing surgical precision and minimizing the impact on surrounding tissues. The surgeon retains responsibility for medical decisions throughout the procedure.
    -- SPA
